q: Action was taken before the draft was written. What still has to match afterwards?

Based on **emergency-spend-ceiling**: when money moves in a genuine emergency before a draft exists, the person who authorized it still must match the authority required for that spend under the ordinary spend-band table — i.e., the *authorizing signature* still has to be at the correct level (team lead only under 500,000 KRW, division head or team-lead-with-verbal-sign-off under 3,000,000 KRW, CEO verbal sign-off at/above that). Filing the draft afterward on time does not retroactively fix the wrong person having approved it — the authority on the after-the-fact draft still has to match what the ordinary bands required at the time the spend occurred.
